g.text: 6 - REAL RUNTIMES (the bar: loads + renders like mgfxc / fxc)
Bundled native binaries (the blue boxes - ride inside the NuGet, no fxc / mgfxc / Wine / SDK)
(+ d3dcompiler_47) = desktop only (DX/FNA, not on the GL/Android path)
Delivery shapes (one and the same library)
(ShadowDusk.ContentPipeline: the same importer/processor as a lib for MonoGame 3.8.5's C# ContentBuilder) |
(CompiledShader.ToXnb() / an .xnb CLI output path - Content.Load<Effect> ready, MGCB not involved) |
self-contained on Linux / macOS / Windows + Browser (WASM) +
(GL path; on-device DXC + SPIRV-Cross built for android-arm64/x86_64, loaded in-process from the APK lib/[abi]/ dir)

(ShadowDusk.Compiler.Slang) - .slang joins .fx/.glsl as an accepted INPUT; no Slang binary shipped or invoked, pure managed text transform; no mgfxc oracle exists for Slang, so no Slang route is ever mgfxc-equivalent.

(ShadowDusk.Compiler.Sksl) - converts a pixel-only .fx to SkSL text for SkiaSharp's SKRuntimeEffect; evidence is rendered-image fidelity against the original HLSL, never mgfxc-equivalence (Skia has no reference compiler).
technique synthesized; body compiles as HLSL
coordinate-driven; no varyings, no vertex stage)
bundled in the NuGet - DXC, SPIRV-Cross, vkd3d
(loads on MonoGame + KNI desktop + KNI WebGL).
KNIFX now loads on KNI desktop GL + mobile GLES + WebGL (one GL-family .knifx).
